posts.name: GURVEER SINGH SEKHON
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir/Ma’am

I had a question regarding the grading policy for the course.

If a student is present for the End Term exam and has decent marks in quizzes, assignments, and BPTs, but does not pass the OPE (the result is still awaited), how is the final score calculated?

Will the BPT marks still be included in the final score calculation (as per the formula), or will only the Quiz, Graded Assignments, and End Term marks be considered?

Also, if the final score is above the required threshold (≥35 or ≥40 as per the policy) but the OPE is failed, will the student be allowed to carry forward the GA, quiz, and End Term scores and just repeat the OPE and BPTs in the next term as per the I_OP grade?

I’d appreciate some clarification on how this would work. @sayan @AtulPS @Puneet_21f3002005

Thank you!

image1139×729 77.8 KB

posts.name: MAYANK BHARTI
posts.cooked: If you don’t pass oppe then you’ll get an I_OP , and during course registration if you register for System Commands then you’ll get 2 options , either you repeat the whole course where you have to do everything or just give the OPPE where You have to do BPT’S again to be eligible for OPPE but other scores will be carried forward .

posts.name: GURVEER SINGH SEKHON
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the clarification regarding the I_OP scenario.

But I wanted to clarify — in this current term, if I clear the End Term exam and the final score (as per the grading formula) is calculated, does that score include the BPT marks from this term, or is it calculated using only the Quiz, Graded Assignments, and End Term marks?

I’m asking this specifically to understand whether the BPT scores from this term are factored into the final score even if the OPE is not passed.

posts.name: MAYANK BHARTI
posts.cooked: I think that BPT’s score will be taken into account of this term for this term for calculation of overall score because anyway you’ve given all exams so all fields of Term score are filled with some value . Next term BPT Value will change as you have to do BPT again but it will be better to confirm from the Course team .

posts.name: GURVEER SINGH SEKHON
posts.cooked:
I also hope someone from the course team can confirm this for clarity.

Thanks for your input!

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
@23f2004941
From this term the following components are taken -

BPTs, GAA, Qz1 and ET score is taken for final score. BPTs score from this term will be considered. Right now you will get I_OP.

Next term you have to do BPTs for eligibility for the oppe but BPT marks from May term is considered in the final score. If you get >=40 in OPPE that marks is added to the final score and you will get the grade which is added to CGPA.
